title: Lemma 8.1.3, first part: the plane-distribution measures η_V^(x) exist μ_V-a.e.
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on an open set U ⊆ ℝ^N with weight μ_V. Then for μ_V-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^N there is a Borel probability measure η on G = G(N,n) such that, for every continuous β : G → ℝ, (∫_{B_ρ(x)×G} β(S) dV(y,S)) / μ_V(B_ρ(x)) → ∫ β dη as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the closed ball, and the quotient is the Bochner integral divided by the real number μ_V(B_ρ(x)).toReal, with t/0 = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ η : Measure (Grassmannian N n), IsProbabilityMeasure η ∧ ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ S, β S ∂η))
